name: Proton VPN
description: Open Proton VPN controls and connect through its official Linux service
author: spotty
help:
Optional Proton VPN search trigger and service controls

Installing adds the `vpn` trigger and a Proton VPN row under Settings → Search → Services and integrations. The popup shows connection status and can sign in, connect, disconnect, and sign out using Proton's official Linux CLI. Proton's package owns its privileged background service; Spotty does not install system packages, implement its own tunnel, or connect automatically when you install this integration.

The sign-in dialog asks for your Proton username, then opens Proton's CLI in a terminal for your password and any security-key or two-factor prompts. Spotty never reads or stores the password or second factor.

Uninstalling removes the Spotty trigger and controls only; it leaves Proton's package, account, and current connection untouched. Proton's Linux GUI and CLI cannot run at the same time.
